decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The primary docs page is now titled "About local sandboxing" and its hash changed. It still separates local from usage-billed cloud sandboxing. Billing docs still meter compute, memory and snapshot storage. No source states a lifecycle stage, so public preview is not re-confirmed. No policy, audit or data-retention source was fetched. All gates stay unknown; human dates are not renewed.

citations.quote: Cloud sandboxing : Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub. Cloud sandboxing is billed based on usage.
Storage : snapshot storage for stopped sessions.

findings.reason: Fetched docs give no release stage or account eligibility for cloud sandboxes.
findings.next: Confirm the stage, eligible plans and client versions in a primary source.

findings.reason: No fetched source describes an enterprise policy to disable cloud sandboxes.
findings.next: Find the official policy doc and run a negative enforcement test.

findings.reason: Fetched sources do not describe credentials or repository scope inside a sandbox.
findings.next: Review identity flow, scopes and exposed environment variables.

findings.reason: Billing docs say stopped sessions keep a snapshot. Retention, deletion and residency are not documented in fetched text.
findings.next: Find retention, deletion and residency evidence; test with synthetic data.

findings.reason: No fetched source defines approval boundaries or stop controls for sandboxed agent actions.
findings.next: Run an untrusted-instruction test and document the stop path.

findings.reason: No fetched source covers audit logs or session trace export.
findings.next: Reconstruct a synthetic run and identify trace gaps.

findings.reason: Billing docs list compute, memory and snapshot-storage meters. Observed usage and a billing stop are not measured.
findings.next: Measure a rehearsal and test the effective budget policy.

findings.reason: The fetched pages do not state egress controls or endpoint allowlists for cloud sandboxes.
findings.next: Validate allowed and denied destinations on the actual surface.

findings.reason: Support expectations and preview limits are not stated in fetched sources.
findings.next: Record risk acceptance, support route and incident owner.

findings.reason: Stop versus delete lifecycle for remote snapshots is not established by fetched text.
findings.next: Document remote cleanup and verify after reset.
